items.title: Freeze Layer 2 suite schema and proof root
items.context: Confirm the selected artifacts root, baseline artifact schema, required ENG baseline IDs, and proof binding fields before implementation. Related decision doc requires baselineId, suiteRunId, claimTarget, materialHash, and receipt binding to be explicit.
items.userSees: User sees schema freeze output listing artifactsRoot, required ENG baseline IDs, and mandatory binding fields.

happy.desc: Schema exposes all nine ENG baseline IDs and required binding fields baselineId, suiteRunId, claimTarget, headHash, materialHash, evidence refs, and receipt refs.

edge.desc: Schema rejects unsupported baseline IDs or missing binding fields instead of silently accepting them.

adversarial.desc: A report with mismatched layer or missing required proof fields cannot be treated as formal Engineering proof.

items.title: Pin or ingest Layer 1 Development proof into the selected artifacts root
items.context: Layer 1 being globally complete is not sufficient. The Engineering suite must see fresh Development lower-layer proof in the same selected artifacts root or a digest-pinned equivalent.
items.userSees: User sees lower-layer Development proof pinned or ingested in the selected artifacts root, with stale or missing proof reported as blocked.

happy.desc: Engineering suite consumes fresh Development lower-layer proof from the selected artifacts root or digest-pinned equivalent.

edge.desc: Missing Development proof keeps Engineering suite BLOCKED.

adversarial.desc: Stale or mismatched lower-layer proof is refused and cannot unlock Layer 2.

items.title: Build the formal proof-producing path for Engineering final reports
items.context: Diagnostic baseline_run output is localOnly=true and capabilityProof=false. Formal ENG final reports may set localOnly=false and capabilityProof=true only after required proof validation, receipt verification, and gate consumption pass.
items.userSees: User sees formal Engineering final reports marked capabilityProof=true and localOnly=false only after proof validation succeeds.

happy.desc: Formal proof-producing path can emit accepted ENG final reports only after validation of evidence, receipts, and gate consumption inputs.

edge.desc: Diagnostic baseline_run reports remain localOnly=true and capabilityProof=false.

adversarial.desc: A caller cannot set formal proof flags without required proof inputs.

items.title: Execute all nine Engineering baselines through formal proof production
items.context: Run ENG-MULTI-FILE-1, ENG-EXISTING-REPO-1, ENG-BUGFIX-1, ENG-REGRESSION-1, ENG-DATA-MIGRATION-1, ENG-AUTH-SECURITY-1, ENG-FRONTEND-VISUAL-1, ENG-LONG-RUN-1, and ENG-LOOP-REVIEW-1 with dual-host review evidence and no fake PASS.
items.userSees: User sees all nine ENG baselines represented in formal proof output, with no skipped baseline and no fake PASS.

happy.desc: All nine ENG baselines produce supported formal outcomes.

edge.desc: Expected-block baselines can report EXPECTED_BLOCK only with refusal or gate evidence.

adversarial.desc: Skipped, failed, or inconsistent baseline output prevents suite PASS.

items.title: Verify and consume Authority receipt refs with baseline and claim binding
items.context: Authority-backed proof must bind story, phase, baselineId, suiteRunId, claimTarget, headHash, materialHash, evidence digests, and run bindings. Missing or mismatched binding must fail closed.
items.userSees: User sees Authority receipt refs verified and bound to baselineId, suiteRunId, claimTarget, headHash, materialHash, and evidence digests.

happy.desc: Formal proof accepts receipt refs only when all baseline, suite, claim, head, material, and evidence bindings match.

edge.desc: Missing required receipt binding fields fail closed.

adversarial.desc: A valid receipt from another baseline, suite run, or claim target is rejected.

items.title: Generate Engineering suite report from formal reports
items.context: The suite report must only accept fresh formal reports. It must reject localOnly=true, capabilityProof=false, stale materialHash, missing lower-layer proof, and inconsistent outcomes.
items.userSees: User sees Engineering suite report PASS only from fresh formal reports; otherwise it reports BLOCKED with reasons.

happy.desc: Engineering suite report accepts all required fresh formal reports and emits suiteStatus=PASS, authorization=authorized, capabilityProof=true, localOnly=false.

edge.desc: Malformed, stale, mixed-schema, missing lower-layer, or local-only reports keep the suite BLOCKED.

adversarial.desc: Inconsistent report outcomes cannot be aggregated into a PASS suite.

items.title: Run formal Layer 2 claim evaluation or block if only diagnostic evaluator exists
items.context: Current capability_claim_evaluate is L0/read-only diagnostic. Formal unlock requires a real Layer 2 evaluator or a fail-closed blocked result if no formal evaluator exists.
items.userSees: User sees Layer 2 Engineering claim UNLOCKED only from formal suite proof, or NOT_AUTHORIZED when only diagnostic proof exists.

happy.desc: Formal Layer 2 claim evaluator unlocks only the Engineering Baseline claim from accepted formal suite proof.

edge.desc: If only the diagnostic evaluator path exists, output remains NOT_AUTHORIZED or BLOCKED rather than unlocked.

adversarial.desc: A local diagnostic claim report cannot be relabeled as formal authorization.

items.title: Verify higher layers remain locked
items.context: Layer 2 unlock must not unlock Loop Engineering, Production Safety, or global Capability Claim. Higher-layer claim requests must remain NOT_AUTHORIZED unless separately proven.
items.userSees: User sees Layer 3 Loop Engineering, Layer 4 Production Safety, and Layer 5/global Capability Claim remain LOCKED after Layer 2 unlock.

happy.desc: After Engineering proof passes, higher-layer claim evaluations remain not_authorized without their own proof.

edge.desc: Production-safety and capability-claim targets report missing lower-layer, soak, or authority prerequisites rather than PASS.

adversarial.desc: Engineering receipts or suite reports cannot be reused to unlock Loop, Production, or global claims.
